item.title: K8S Security Framework and RBAC in Action: Fine-Grained User & Group Access Control with CFSSL Certificates
item.description: A comprehensive guide to the Kubernetes security framework (Authentication, Authorization, Admission Control) and RBAC core model: hands-on demonstration of issuing certificates for Users and Groups using CFSSL, scripting kubeconfig generation, and configuring Role/ClusterRole bindings with boundary validation.
